name: Realtek - Ethernet
description: Optimizes Ethernet for the lowest and most stable ping by prioritizing performance and responsiveness over power saving as well as disabling useless network features.
commands:
if (-NOT ([Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal][Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()).IsInRole(
    [Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole] "Administrator"
)) { exit }

$adapterKeyPath = "HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Class\{4D36E972-E325-11CE-BFC1-08002BE10318}"
$allAdapters    = Get-ChildItem $adapterKeyPath -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

function Set-NicRegString {
    param(
        [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$Path,
        [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$Name,
        [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][string]$Value
    )
    try {
        New-ItemProperty -Path $Path -Name $Name -Value $Value -PropertyType String -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null
    } catch {}
}

$regPairs = [ordered]@{
    "*EncapsulatedPacketTaskOffloadNvgre" = "1"
    "*EncapsulatedPacketTaskOffloadVxlan" = "1"
    "*IdleRestriction"                    = "1"
    "*EncapsulatedPacketTaskOffload"      = "1"
    "*IPChecksumOffloadIPv4"              = "3"
    "*LsoV1IPv4"                          = "1"
    "*LsoV2IPv4"                          = "1"
    "*LsoV2IPv6"                          = "1"
    "*TCPChecksumOffloadIPv4"             = "3"
    "*TCPChecksumOffloadIPv6"             = "3"
    "*UDPChecksumOffloadIPv4"             = "3"
    "*UDPChecksumOffloadIPv6"             = "3"
    "*IPsecOffloadV1IPv4"                 = "3"
    "*IPsecOffloadV2"                     = "3"
    "*IPsecOffloadV2IPv4"                 = "3"
    "*TCPConnectionOffloadIPv4"           = "3"
    "*TCPConnectionOffloadIPv6"           = "3"
    "*TCPUDPChecksumOffloadIPv4"          = "3"
    "*TCPUDPChecksumOffloadIPv6"          = "3"
    "*UsoIPv4"                            = "1"
    "*UsoIPv6"                            = "1"
    "*VMQ"                                = "0"
    "VMQSupported"                        = "0"
    "*RscIPv4"                            = "1"
    "*RscIPv6"                            = "1"
    "*UdpRsc"                             = "1"
    "ForceRscEnabled"                     = "1"
    "*InterruptModeration"                = "1"
    "*ReceiveBuffers"                     = "4096"
    "*TransmitBuffers"                    = "4096"
    "EnableAdaptiveQueuing"               = "0"
    "StoreBadPackets"                     = "0"
    "*StoreBadPackets"                    = "0"
    "DynamicLTR"                          = "0"
    "DropHighlyFragmentedPacket"          = "1"
    "EnableCoalesce"                      = "0"
    "*PacketDirect"                       = "1"
    "AllowFlowControlFrames"              = "0"
    "*FlowControl"                        = "0"
    "EnableTss"                           = "1"
    "*PriorityVLANTag"                    = "0"
    "*EEE"                                = "0"
    "*SelectiveSuspend"                   = "0"
    "*WakeOnMagicPacket"                  = "0"
    "*WakeOnPattern"                      = "0"
    "*DeviceSleepOnDisconnect"            = "0"
    "*SSIdleTimeout"                      = "0"
    "*SSIdleTimeoutScreenOff"             = "0"
    "AdvancedEEE"                         = "0"
    "ASPM"                                = "0"
    "CLKREQ"                              = "0"
    "EEEPlus"                             = "0"
    "EnableAspm"                          = "0"
    "EnableGreenEthernet"                 = "0"
    "GPPSW"                               = "0"
    "EPSDRT"                              = "0"
    "GigaLite"                            = "0"
    "LTROBF"                              = "0"
    "PowerDownPll"                        = "0"
    "PowerSavingMode"                     = "0"
    "*PMARPOffload"                       = "1"
    "*PMNSOffload"                        = "1"
    "*PMWiFiRekeyOffload"                 = "1"
}

$ethAdapters = $allAdapters | Where-Object {
    $d = (Get-ItemProperty $_.PSPath -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).DriverDesc
    $d -match "Ethernet|LAN|GbE|Realtek|Intel|Killer|Broadcom|Qualcomm|BCM"
}

$wifiAdapters = $allAdapters | Where-Object {
    $d = (Get-ItemProperty $_.PSPath -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).DriverDesc
    $d -match "Wi-?Fi|Wireless|Realtek|Intel|Killer|Broadcom|Qualcomm|Atheros|BCM"
}

$targets = @($ethAdapters + $wifiAdapters) | Select-Object -Unique

foreach ($adapter in $targets) {
    $path = $adapter.PSPath
    foreach ($kv in $regPairs.GetEnumerator()) {
        Set-NicRegString -Path $path -Name $kv.Key -Value $kv.Value
    }
}
